title: Select Show Tickets from 30% off: 40% off Guns N' Roses, 30% off 5 Seconds of Summer, Charlie Puth & More + Fees @ Live Nation
body:
Deal: Select Show Tickets from 30% off: 40% off Guns N' Roses, 30% off 5 Seconds of Summer, Charlie Puth & More + Fees @ Live Nation

[cityb7] No, Alex Warren is run by Frontier Touring, not Live Nation, so not included in this promotion.
[anastasiastarz] Yep, kinda amazed we got Taylor Swift tix but not HD
[cityb7] Benson Boone wasn't apart of this at all. His concerts are run by Frontier Touring, not Live Nation.
[fantombloo] 40% off Guns N' Roses
So the price it should have always been. Nice.
[cityb7] Yeah, the original prices they were charging were not worth it for 2026 GNR. I copped these discounted tickets purely because I've never seen them and I don't know if they'll come back.
[fantombloo] Good luck, I hope they put on a good show. (Quicktothepointless' link below might suggest otherwise. 😭)
[QuickToThePointless] big fan of 80's/90's gunners…but 20's gunners live?
just gonna drop this right here…
[Pusdi] My favourite band in the late 80s and early 90s. Slash has still got it but I can't bare Axl's voice any more
[astrotrain] Jungle would be cool! Wish i got to see them at the Hordern last time they came down.
[freoleo] Some of these just don't appear to work
Are there codes that are meant to be entered or something? clicking through the christmas in july tickets comes up with the same price as standard
Feel like they are banking on people not thinking and paying the full price…
[cityb7] No I've checked and they are all discounted. They aren't always labelled super obvious, but on all the ones I've bought on both Ticketmaster and Ticketek, it's marked as "Xmas in July Offer" or similar somewhere on the order. I don't believe there's any codes required.
[freoleo] Strummingbird isn't discounted
I don't think Mel C is either
[cityb7] Strummingbird isn't all tickets, it's a "GA + Shotgun Fast Pass and Drinks Bundle" that's a special offer.
Mel C Sydney & Brisbane tickets are discounted, and I think Melbourne might be sold out already. I'm not sure if the rest are just not marked as discounted or if the sale just doesn't apply to them, but it does seem weird.
[freoleo] @cityb7: Have no idea how you're supposed to access those tickets for Strummingbird, also can't find where on the page it says that?
Mel C weren't discounted in Perth (I'm from Perth)
[cityb7] @freoleo: I'm using Ballarat as an example, but you can see the discounted tickets as the first option on this page: https://www.moshtix.com.au/v2/event/strummingbird-ballarat-2…
I know they aren't specific about it on the website which sucks, but this is what they're offering.
Not much more I can say about Mel C, I saw they aren't discounted in Perth and I don't know why, weather it's a mistake on their end or weather they aren't discounted for a reason.
[freoleo] @cityb7: See thats where things go wrong, I don't get directed to that page when I click through the Christmas in July tickets link, (That bundle doesn't appear but works in your link) now can see they are atleast offering something (It's a terrible offer though lol but atleast something)
quick edit: looks like it applied a code in the end for that page XMASINJULY
[cityb7] @freoleo: I think once you get off the Live Nation site, you need to click through the Moshtix site to the specific date you want. I don't know, it's weird, but they technically aren't lying even if it's a bad deal. I'm glad I could help though.
[TheDukeOfNukem] I grabbed a couple for GnR the other day at 60 a pop, largely out of continued spite for a friend who is a diehard but can't pull $100 together by year's end to go, and couldn't last time at the G either, long story. Anyway,
Reason I'm commenting is, I have hope. Motley and Def Lep are garbage in video too, but my God, when they were here a couple years ago, they both sounded fantastic. Motley, to be fair, Vince missed (intentionally) many a word, and they almost certainly are playing with tracks at times, Def Lep seemed pretty (profanity) legit though. Joe's voice has definitely got better, maybe he got a surgery, idk. Anyway, point is, for 60 bucks, they might surprise you.
And worst case, if they don't, Australia's own Airbourne kick mad (profanity) arse and you'll get your money's worth on them as the opener!
[cityb7] I went to AC/DC last year, and I was scared about Brian's voice as well, but boy they still did great, and anything lost on his voice was made up for with the show and just generally seeing AC/DC live. I'm hoping this will be the same.
Don't know much about Airbourne so hoping you're correct, heard a lot of good things.
[billbob123454] Thanks. $60 worth the punt for a cheap night out with family.
